catalog.heading: Catalog
catalog.description: One row per variant, separate from the stock Products page. Columns contributed by installed plugins render alongside the base columns. Click a row to open that variant.
catalog.priceTooltip: This variant has no price set. That is normal for a variant that is not offered for sale.
catalog.srpTooltipMissing: No srp in this variant's or its product's metadata.
catalog.srpTooltipWithCurrency: SRP from metadata, in the currency recorded beside it.
catalog.srpTooltipNoCurrency: SRP from metadata. No srp_currency is recorded beside it, so no currency is shown.
catalog.stockTooltipUntracked: Medusa does not manage inventory for this variant, so there is no quantity to show.
catalog.stockTooltipUnknown: No stock level came back for this variant.
